By way of present appeal, challenge has been laid to an award dated 01.12.2001 0 passed by the learned Reference Court- Court cum-Addl.
Addl. District Judge, Gurdaspur.
2.

Briefly stating, in the present case, some land owned by the appellants appellant situated in the revenue estate of Village Tharra Jhikla Teeka Doong, Tehsil Dhar Kalan, Pathankot (erstwhile district Gurdaspur) came to be acquired vide notifications dated 23.06.1995 and 24.11.1995 issued under Sections 4 and 6 respectively of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (hereinafter referred to as 'the Act').
The acquisition was carried out for public purpose, namely, for Hydel Channel of Shahpurkandi Dam Project Project..

At the time of acquisition, RFA-199 1992-2002 (O&M) [2]
certain construction was already existing over the land in question regarding which award was passed by Land Acquisition Collector (for short 'the LAC') L on 12.03.1998 granting compensation to the tune of Rs.2,65,020 2,65,020/- to the landowner(s).
Being aggrieved thereof,, the appellant appellants-landowners sought reference under Section 18 of the Act which came to be dismissed.
Aggrieved of the decision dated 01.12.20 .2001, the present esent appeal has been preferred.
